standard_prerequisites.name: A bounded coherent complex on a Noetherian scheme pushes forward to a bounded coherent complex, and on Noetherian schemes bounded coherent means pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces perfectness of Rf_*E to finite tor dimension.

standard_prerequisites.name: A pseudo-coherent complex is perfect exactly when it has finite tor dimension, detected by universally bounded cohomology after tensoring with all quasi-coherent sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the criterion the rest of the proof verifies.

standard_prerequisites.name: The union of the supports of the cohomology sheaves is proper over the base and contained in a quasi-compact open, and the complex restricts to zero outside its support
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows replacing X by a quasi-compact open, making f quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

standard_prerequisites.name: The derived tensor of the pushforward with a quasi-coherent sheaf identifies with the pushforward of the tensor with the pulled back sheaf, and relative tor dimension bounds the cohomology of the inner tensor
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the universal boundedness of the cohomology.

core_obligations: By Lemma direct-image-coherent, Rf_*E lies in D^b_Coh(O_S), hence is pseudo-coherent by Lemma identify-pseudo-coherent-noetherian; so by Cohomology, Lemma perfect it suffices to show Rf_*E has finite tor dimension (proof lines 7001-7006).

By Lemma tor-qc-qs it suffices to check that Rf_*(E) tensor^L F has universally bounded cohomology for all quasi-coherent F on S; bounded above is clear since Rf_*E is bounded above (proof lines 7007-7011).

Let T be the union of the supports of the H^i(E); T is proper over S by assumptions (1) and (2) (Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma union-closed-proper-over-base), so there is a quasi-compact open X' containing T; since E restricts to zero outside T, Rf_*E = Rf'_*(E|_{X'}) with f' = f|_{X'}; replace X by X' so that f is quasi-compact, and it is quasi-separated by Morphisms, Lemma finite-type-Noetherian-quasi-separated (proof lines 7013-7024).

Compute Rf_*(E) tensor^L F = Rf_*(E tensor^L Lf^*F) = Rf_*(E tensor^L_{f^{-1}O_S} f^{-1}F) by Lemma cohomology-base-change and Cohomology, Lemma variant-derived-pullback; by assumption (3) the inner complex has cohomology sheaves in a finite range [a, b], and Rf_* of it has cohomology in [a, infinity), giving the universal upper bound and finishing the proof (proof lines 7025-7035).
proof_roadmap: Reduce perfectness to finite tor dimension via pseudo-coherence (proof lines 7001-7006).
State the tensor criterion for tor dimension (proof lines 7007-7011).
Restrict to a quasi-compact open containing the proper support (proof lines 7013-7024).
Rewrite the tensor through base change and bound by relative tor dimension (proof lines 7025-7035).
